app.name: Status & action
app.summary: Shows one entity's state and taps a second one: a script, a toggle, a scene.
app.tile_example: Alarm: Disarmed, a tap runs the night script
app.opt_status_hint: The entity whose state the tile shows, such as alarm_control_panel.alarmo or a sensor.
app.opt_target_hint: A second entity a tap switches or triggers: a script, a switch, a scene, a button.
app.opt_action_hint: Toggle it, turn it on, turn it off, or press it (for a button).
app.opt_confirm_hint: The first tap asks, the second acts. For a target that matters, such as an alarm.
app.opt_confirm_lang_hint: The words of the "tap again" prompt when Ask before acting is on.
app.opt_text_size_hint: How big the state word is: large fills the tile, small leaves more room.
app.opt_show_action_hint: Off hides the target's name and gives the state the whole tile.
app.opt_color_calm_hint: The colour of the resting states (off, disarmed, closed, locked, home, idle). Default keeps each state's built-in colour.
app.opt_color_active_hint: The colour of the engaged states (on, armed, open, unlocked). Default keeps each state's built-in colour. The alert states (triggered, arming, pending) always keep their red or amber.
app.opt_icon_calm_hint: An icon for the resting states (off, disarmed, closed, locked, home, idle), in place of the dot. None keeps the dot.
app.opt_icon_active_hint: An icon for the engaged states (on, armed, open, unlocked), in place of the dot. None keeps the dot.
app.opt_icon_alert_hint: An icon for the alert states (triggered, arming, pending), in place of the dot. None keeps the dot.
